description: Implement the next-stage optional features for the Telegram-first interview copilot: OCR or multimodal extraction for image-first bundles, safer Telegram message grouping for split inputs, and a Feishu adapter that reuses the SourceBundle-based pipeline.

userStories.title: Add OCR or multimodal media extraction
userStories.description: As the user, I want screenshot-heavy bundles to be readable so that image-first interview posts can also enter the same pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Downloaded Telegram assets can be converted into text with OCR or multimodal models
Media-derived text is merged into the same SourceBundle-driven normalization path before question extraction
OCR or multimodal extraction can process at least one local image file without requiring a reachable Xiaohongshu web page
Media extraction failures are surfaced clearly without corrupting the original raw bundle
userStories.notes: Implement the smallest stable path first: local image file -> extracted text -> normalize. Prefer compatibility with the existing OpenAI-compatible stack and LangChain message format.

userStories.title: Add safer Telegram message grouping
userStories.description: As the user, I want related Telegram messages sent close together to be grouped into one logical bundle so that links and follow-up text are processed together without merging unrelated messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Grouping only merges messages from the same chat under explicit, conservative rules
The grouping strategy supports the common case of link preview followed by explanatory text without over-grouping unrelated messages
Grouped bundles remain replayable and traceable to original message ids and retain a safe reply target
Grouping failures do not break the one-shot orchestration path
userStories.notes: Stability matters more than recall. It is acceptable to under-group if that avoids accidental cross-message merges.

userStories.title: Add Feishu source adapter
userStories.description: As the user, I want Feishu messages to enter the same pipeline so that another collaboration tool can reuse the SourceBundle-based workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Feishu inbound event payloads can be mapped into the shared SourceBundle schema
The adapter supports at least text message events and preserves provider-specific metadata for debugging
Feishu-derived bundles can reuse existing normalization, generation, archival, and reply-adjacent workflows without source-specific redesign
The adapter handles unsupported event shapes clearly instead of crashing
userStories.notes: A minimal adapter may begin with one-shot event ingestion from a webhook payload or file-backed event sample, as long as it proves the SourceBundle reuse path.
